name: Whitespace
summary: Stack-based language by Edwin Brady and Chris Morris (2003) whose only significant characters are space, tab and line feed.

level_notes.1: The original tutorial/spec at compsoc.dur.ac.uk is offline and the Wayback copies could not be verified from here; esolangs.org reproduces the instruction table.
level_notes.0: No verified implementation repository linked; implementations are listed on the esolangs.org page.
level_notes.2: Little secondary literature exists beyond the wiki/encyclopedia entries.
